_comment: Pre-registered acceptance rules for a layout candidate (plans/layout-iteracion-1.md, fase 5). Change them only before rendering a candidate, never after seeing its results.
hiddenMessageFlowsNote: User decision 2026-09-25, taken after the v1 votes and before rendering v2: message flows are hidden in what the user receives, so hard constraints are counted with them (and their labels) removed. Legibility metrics still see them.
areaGrowthMaxNote: A candidate may not exceed the base diagram area by more than this fraction in any case unless the visual judge justifies it.
